note: Floors and ceilings for `python -m hr_timeoff_agent gate`. Set 2026-10-03 from three live runs on the Claude Code backend, with wide margin, because the API path has not been measured over all five cases yet. Measured: single grounded 2.6 / cites 2.6-2.8 / tone 2.4-2.6, about $0.008 and 4-5 s per triage; multi grounded 2.8-3.0 / cites 2.0-2.8 / tone 2.4-2.6, $0.041-0.044 and 23-30 s, 4.4-4.8 tool calls; multi over A2A $0.046 and 27 s. Tighten after the first scheduled runs on the API path: set each floor just under the worst result seen, and each ceiling at about twice the worst. n=5 cases, so one case moves a mean by 0.6 (multi's cites mean moved from 2.0 to 2.8 between two runs of the same code): do not set a floor above what one bad case would still clear unless that case is a real regression.
